question: Where can I locate café within 130 kilometers when heading toward Miami Sun Hotel, Miami, FL starting at Cox Science Center and Aquarium, West Palm Beach, FL?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry AS geom FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Cox Science Center and Aquarium%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%West Palm Beach%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%FL%' LIMIT 1 ), destination_point AS ( SELECT geometry AS geom FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Miami Sun Hotel%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Miami%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%FL%' LIMIT 1 ), target_bearing AS ( SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(sp.geom, dp.geom)) AS bearing_deg FROM start_point sp, destination_point dp ), cafes_in_range AS ( SELECT p.poi_name, p.geometry AS cafe_geom, degrees(ST_Azimuth(sp.geom, p.geometry)) AS cafe_bearing_deg, tb.bearing_deg AS target_bearing_deg FROM pois p, start_point sp, target_bearing tb WHERE p.amenity = 'cafe' AND ST_DWithin(sp.geom::geography, p.geometry::geography, 130000) -- 130 kilometers in meters ) SELECT poi_name FROM cafes_in_range WHERE -- Filter by direction: within +/- 22.5 degrees of the target bearing (a 45-degree cone) ABS( ATAN2( SIN(RADIANS(cafe_bearing_deg - target_bearing_deg)), COS(RADIANS(cafe_bearing_deg - target_bearing_deg)) ) ) <= RADIANS(22.5) ORDER BY ST_Distance( (SELECT geom FROM start_point)::geography, cafe_geom::geography ) ASC;
